umi3_1-L0006.text: Rudolf and Hideyoshi went out onto the deck, and took out some cigarettes. Eva had always hated the smell of cigarettes, but when she was in a bad mood, she got even more oversensitive. The two of them had attempted to spend some relaxed time smoking until they made it to the island, but they had gotten yelled at and chased out onto the deck.

Hideyoshi tried to use his lighter, but it didn't go well with all of the strong winds on the deck.
Rudolf took out a Zippo with a stylish gesture, and let Hideyoshi borrow the flame.

umi3_1-L0012.text: "Just after the war. In the beginnin', I was rollin' 'em. Then I started usin' what I was sellin'. Wahahahahahahaha."

In the beginnin', I was rollin' 'em.

Wahahahahahahaha."

umi3_1-L0016.text: "So you were already smoking when you met Aneki. I'll bet she's always telling you to stop."
runs: "So you were already smoking when you met Aneki.
I'll bet she's always telling you to stop."
umi3_1-L0016.speaker: Ushiromiya Rudolf

umi3_1-L0018.text: "I never listened to her, so she's already completely given up on that. Wahaha, looks like men've gotta be stubborn."
runs: "I never listened to her, so she's already completely given up on that.
Wahaha, looks like men've gotta be stubborn."
umi3_1-L0018.speaker: Ushiromiya Hideyoshi

umi3_1-L0020.text: Hideyoshi laughed heartily, but Rudolf chuckled. After being scolded by Eva and told to smoke outside, they had dejectedly fled to the deck together. There was almost no doubt he was under her thumb.

......Nah, she's usually a more gentle, quiet woman.
Every year, she changes when this day comes."

To me, she looks just like the Aneki we've all known for so long."

...But, that's different from the Eva who's with me."
umi3_1-L0028.speaker: Ushiromiya Hideyoshi

umi3_1-L0031.text: ".................. Well, I can understand why she's grumpy. ...This family conference is going to be a pain."

...This family conference is going to be a pain."

umi3_1-L0034.text: "......Sure is. ...That plan to threaten money out of Krauss nii‐san. It's a family conference only in name, really it's just a fight between siblings."

It's a family conference only in name, really it's just a fight between siblings."

umi3_1-L0037.text: With the family conference ahead of them, the three siblings excluding Krauss had made a secret contract. Each of them had a pressing situation to deal with, and urgently needed a lot of money. And the only one who could help them was Krauss, who spoke for the Ushiromiya head, since Kinzo was shut up in his study.

umi3_1-L0040.text: They had long felt that Krauss had started taking advantage of Kinzo's loss of interest in his own wealth, and was embezzling that wealth for his own use. When everything had been going well for the siblings, even though they had found it detestable, they had pretended not to notice, ...but now that they needed money, they couldn't just quietly accept that.

umi3_1-L0044.text: Eva had called Rudolf and Rosa into an alliance, and they were planning to exploit that knowledge in order to draw money out of Krauss...
runs: Eva had called Rudolf and Rosa into an alliance, and they were planning to exploit that knowledge in order to draw money out of Krauss...

umi3_1-L0045.text: ".........Rudolf‐kun, both you and I are company presidents. We are responsible for the livelihood of our employees."

Well, as a hobby."

umi3_1-L0049.text: "That's right, sorry. ......In short, all of us are bearin' some burden."
runs: "That's right, sorry.
......In short, all of us are bearin' some burden."
umi3_1-L0049.speaker: Ushiromiya Hideyoshi

umi3_1-L0051.text: "...Now that I've thrown the gauntlet down in front of the executive board, I gotta bring in the money, even if it means I have to grovel or even drink mud."
runs: "...Now that I've thrown the gauntlet down in front of the executive board, I gotta bring in the money, even if it means I have to grovel or even drink mud."
umi3_1-L0051.speaker: Ushiromiya Rudolf

umi3_1-L0052.text: "Same here. ...I can't betray my employees who've trusted me and followed me for so long. ......That's why I gotta get some money out of Krauss nii‐san, even if I have to grab him by the neck."
runs: "Same here.
...I can't betray my employees who've trusted me and followed me for so long.
......That's why I gotta get some money out of Krauss nii‐san, even if I have to grab him by the neck."
umi3_1-L0052.speaker: Ushiromiya Hideyoshi

umi3_1-L0055.text: "Aneki has always been at odds with Aniki. ...And now she has to have a full‐on confrontation with him. That's probably enough to make her grumpy."
runs: "Aneki has always been at odds with Aniki.
...And now she has to have a full‐on confrontation with him.
That's probably enough to make her grumpy."
umi3_1-L0055.speaker: Ushiromiya Rudolf

umi3_1-L0058.text: "So, Eva has always been on bad terms with Krauss nii‐san, then...?"
runs: "So, Eva has always been on bad terms with Krauss nii‐san, then...?"
umi3_1-L0058.speaker: Ushiromiya Hideyoshi

umi3_1-L0059.text: "She doesn't talk to you about it? Definitely, yeah, in a really big way."
runs: "She doesn't talk to you about it?
Definitely, yeah, in a really big way."
umi3_1-L0059.speaker: Ushiromiya Rudolf

umi3_1-L0061.text: "She won't tell me about the past even if I ask. ......She probably doesn't want to remember."
runs: "She won't tell me about the past even if I ask.
......She probably doesn't want to remember."
umi3_1-L0061.speaker: Ushiromiya Hideyoshi

umi3_1-L0063.text: "...Aneki has always been smart and shrewd. Her grades were good too. Compared to that, Aniki was just average. ...Her just being there beside him should have been enough pressure, but Aneki kept boasting about it and driving Aniki into a corner."

...Her just being there beside him should have been enough pressure, but Aneki kept boasting about it and driving Aniki into a corner."
umi3_1-L0063.speaker: Ushiromiya Rudolf

umi3_1-L0067.text: "......Silly girl... Why be openly hostile like that and drive him into a corner? That's not bein' shrewd."
runs: "......Silly girl...
Why be openly hostile like that and drive him into a corner?
That's not bein' shrewd."
umi3_1-L0067.speaker: Ushiromiya Hideyoshi

runs: "Hahaha, seriously."
umi3_1-L0070.speaker: Ushiromiya Rudolf

umi3_1-L0071.text: ".........Aneki regretted being born a woman. ...She probably couldn't forgive Aniki for getting to succeed the head just because he was a man. ...So she'd always take every opportunity to boast to Dad that she was superior."

...She probably couldn't forgive Aniki for getting to succeed the head just because he was a man.

umi3_1-L0074.text: "Father really is an old‐fashioned person. His values discriminate between men and women. ...You think that Father disliked Eva a bit, since she likes to make herself conspicuous...?"
runs: "Father really is an old‐fashioned person.
His values discriminate between men and women.
...You think that Father disliked Eva a bit, since she likes to make herself conspicuous...?"
umi3_1-L0074.speaker: Ushiromiya Hideyoshi

umi3_1-L0078.text: "Don't you think that schooling for women is like sugar in black tea? Without it, it is bland, but too much of it ruins the tea."
runs: "Don't you think that schooling for women is like sugar in black tea?
Without it, it is bland, but too much of it ruins the tea."
umi3_1-L0078.speaker: Ushiromiya Krauss

umi3_1-L0080.text: ...Since you can still drink black tea without sugar, it was exactly the same as saying that study was unnecessary for a woman. Those infuriating words were ones that my older brother had abused me with when I had been in despair, wanting to go to college but denied by Father.
runs: ...Since you can still drink black tea without sugar,
it was exactly the same as saying that study was unnecessary for a woman.
Those infuriating words were ones that my older brother had abused me with when I had been in despair, wanting to go to college but denied by Father.

umi3_1-L0083.text: I had protested that advancing to college was essential if I was to acquire the education and class befitting the eldest daughter of the Ushiromiya family. But the replies I received from Father and my brother were, in summary, exactly the same. "How conceited for a woman."
runs: I had protested that advancing to college was essential if I was to acquire the education and class befitting the eldest daughter of the Ushiromiya family.
But the replies I received from Father and my brother were, in summary, exactly the same.
"How conceited for a woman."

umi3_1-L0086.text: Since the time I was born into the Ushiromiya family, I hadn't taken that name lightly even once. And furthermore, nor had I ever taken lightly Father's name, Ushiromiya Kinzo.
runs: Since the time I was born into the Ushiromiya family, I hadn't taken that name lightly even once.
And furthermore, nor had I ever taken lightly Father's name, Ushiromiya Kinzo.

umi3_1-L0088.text: It was an old family with a long history, but it had lost all its wealth and its business in the Great Kanto Earthquake, and almost sank for a time. Then Father, with his ingenious talent, had taken control, and revived it to be even greater than it had been before. I hadn't forgotten even once what it meant to be the daughter of that great Ushiromiya Kinzo.

I hadn't forgotten even once what it meant to be the daughter of that great Ushiromiya Kinzo.

umi3_1-L0091.text: Therefore, I had always made every effort to become worthy of that name. Class worthy of the Ushiromiya family. Schooling. Manners. And leadership.
runs: Therefore, I had always made every effort to become worthy of that name.
Class worthy of the Ushiromiya family.
Schooling.
Manners.
And leadership.

umi3_1-L0096.text: Even if I was far from reaching Father's level, I deepened my knowledge in economics and finance, and tried to improve myself so that I could help out with that at any time. ......However, in the end, there never came a time when Father acknowledged that. To Father, a woman was only meant to support a man, and nothing further than that was permissible.

umi3_1-L0099.text:
I wonder when it was that I understood that.
......I probably understood ever since I was a young girl. ...But to truly accept it, I had to wait until I had grown up.

......I probably understood ever since I was a young girl.
...But to truly accept it, I had to wait until I had grown up.

umi3_1-L0102.text: Compared to my own effort, you couldn't have said that Krauss, as my older brother by two years, tried at all to become deserving of the Ushiromiya family name.

tried at all to become deserving of the Ushiromiya family name.

umi3_1-L0104.text: Ever since we were young, my brother kept saying that it was natural that he'd succeed Father, just because he was born a man. ...He kept repeating that, as though it were an absolute gap between us.
runs: Ever since we were young, my brother kept saying that it was natural that he'd succeed Father, just because he was born a man.
...He kept repeating that, as though it were an absolute gap between us.

umi3_1-L0106.text: I couldn't stand it. Even though I always got better grades than my brother, even though I became class president while he was stuck as vice‐president of his class, ...even so, my brother was considered to be the appropriate person to succeed the Ushiromiya family, just because he was a man.

even though I became class president while he was stuck as vice‐president of his class,
...even so, my brother was considered to be the appropriate person to succeed the Ushiromiya family, just because he was a man.

umi3_1-L0110.text:
Of course, you could get away with gender discrimination in those days.
No, it was even considered a virtue in those days. It was a time when women were looked down upon, and it was said that when a woman is born, she is to obey her parents; when she gets married, she is to obey her husband; and when she gets old, she is to obey her children.

umi3_1-L0113.text:
But because that way of thinking existed, I wanted to overturn it.
......Innocently, I kept trying to prove that I was the most fit. ......However, eventually, I realized that all of my efforts were doomed from the beginning.

umi3_1-L0116.text: "Don't you think that schooling for women is like sugar in black tea? Without it, it is bland, but too much of it ruins the tea."

Without it, it is bland, but too much of it ruins the tea."
umi3_1-L0116.speaker: Ushiromiya Krauss

umi3_1-L0118.text: "...What do you mean by that, Nii‐san?"
runs: "...What do you mean by that, Nii‐san?"
umi3_1-L0118.speaker: Ushiromiya Eva

umi3_1-L0119.text: "In the same way that there are things that only men can do, there are also things that only women can do, are there not? I think things like giving birth to children, raising them, and supporting their husband can only be done by women."
runs: "In the same way that there are things that only men can do, there are also things that only women can do, are there not?

umi3_1-L0121.speaker: Ushiromiya Eva

umi3_1-L0122.text: "I wouldn't go that far. Unschooled women are tiring just to talk to. ...However, women who are too smart are even more tiring. I think that a woman like you, who vehemently asserts herself, would cause her future husband a lot of trouble."

umi3_1-L0126.speaker: Ushiromiya Eva

Is my saying that I want to go to college really that odd?!"

In the end, is that really proper for a daughter of the Ushiromiya family?"

umi3_1-L0162.text: "Normally, they don't have to be told that to realize it. They realize it by themselves. ...But no matter how old you get, you haven't realized that about yourself. So as your brother, I will clear away that misunderstanding for you before you exit this house into society. You should thank me."
